untraded_death: Died to {killerName} in {zone} and was not traded within {tradeWindowS} s; the nearest of {teammatesAlive} living {teammatesAlive:teammate|teammates} was {nearestTeammateM} m away.
untraded_death.no_positions: Died to {killerName} in {zone} and was not traded within {tradeWindowS} s while {teammatesAlive} {teammatesAlive:teammate was|teammates were} alive.
shot_while_moving: Fired {movingShots} of {shots} {shots:shot|shots} with the {weapon} while moving at up to {speedUps} u/s in {zone}; accurate speed is {accurateSpeedUps} u/s.
unused_utility: Died in {zone} after {timeAliveS} s with {grenadesUnused} unused {grenadesUnused:grenade|grenades} ({grenadeList}).
dry_peek: Died to {killerName} in {zone} {timeToDeathS} s after first contact, with no flash or smoke from the team before the fight.
dry_peek.instant: Died to {killerName} in {zone} almost at once after first contact, with no flash or smoke from the team before the fight.
team_flash: Own flash blinded {teammatesBlinded} {teammatesBlinded:teammate|teammates} in {zone} (longest {longestBlindS} s) and {enemiesBlinded} {enemiesBlinded:enemy|enemies}.
team_flash.self: Own flash blinded the player for {longestBlindS} s in {zone} and {enemiesBlinded} {enemiesBlinded:enemy|enemies}.
opening_duel.won: Won the opening duel against {opponentName} in {zone} with the {weapon}.
opening_duel.lost: Lost the opening duel to {opponentName} in {zone}.
economy_mismatch.saved_on_buy: Went into round {round} with {equipValue} of equipment and {balance} unspent while the team median was {teamMedianEquip}.
economy_mismatch.forced_on_save: Bought {equipValue} of equipment in round {round} while the team median was {teamMedianEquip}.
late_rotation: Reached {site} {arrivalS} s after the plant, {delayS} s behind the team median of {teamMedianArrivalS} s.
late_rotation.never: Did not reach {site} after the plant; teammates arrived after a median of {teamMedianArrivalS} s.
good_plays.trade_kill: Traded {tradedName} by killing {victimName} {tradeTimeS} s later in {zone}.
good_plays.entry_kill: Opened the round by killing {victimName} in {zone} with the {weapon}.
good_plays.multi_kill: Got {kills} kills in {spanS} s, the last in {zone}.
good_plays.clutch: Won the round as the last player alive against {enemiesAlive} {enemiesAlive:enemy|enemies}, with {killsInClutch} {killsInClutch:kill|kills}.
good_plays.utility_damage: Dealt {utilityDamage} grenade and fire damage to {enemiesHit} {enemiesHit:enemy|enemies}.
untraded_death.not_traded: {teammateName} died {teammateDistanceM} m away; you did not kill {killerName} within {tradeWindowS} s. A clear trade opportunity is not established.
untraded_death.traded_by_teammate: {teammateName} died {teammateDistanceM} m away; another teammate traded the killer after {observedWindowS} s.
untraded_death.player_died: {teammateName} died {teammateDistanceM} m away; you died {observedWindowS} s later without a trade. This does not establish a missed opportunity.
untraded_death.window_incomplete: {teammateName} died {teammateDistanceM} m away; only {observedWindowS} s remained in the round. No personal trade was recorded.
untraded_death.killer_unavailable: {teammateName} died {teammateDistanceM} m away; the killer died by another cause after {observedWindowS} s.
shot_while_moving.review: Fired {movingShots} of {shots} rifle shots above the {accurateSpeedUps} u/s review threshold with the {weapon} during combat in {zone}. Movement alone does not establish a mistake.
